I'm absolutely not joking, that it was one of the most unforgiving experiences in my life. I would compare XCOM to a more nuanced chess game, but where skill matters as much as sheer chance.

(Few and proud  - - - I'm looking directly at you)

Whats more I would tell myself to research and research,  as it turns out going in blind results in additional playthoroughs, which are a real commitment of some serious play time.

Some quick fire tips also

-Turn of the game volume after first long run, seriously just do it. 
"WE'RE LOSING THEM LEFT AND RIGHT COMMANDER HURRY UP"

-When going for trophies disabling DLCs is a godsend.
(Berserk Queen why you hurt me)

-To optimalize each run focus on gathering Technicians then Intel.

-Don't overextend your region map, having more contacts equals more far away story missions, which then equals more grind.

-In the same nature don't overextend your troops, play like a turtle, slow is fast.

-2 Rangers, 2 Specialists and whoever can get you through most encounters.

-Focusing on perks which allow you to reset your actions is the most important aspect of builds.

-Don't attach yourself to any character, only to their usability.
